risk_if_not_implemented: Without Product or Service Delivery Restrictions, delivered products or services may contain defects, unsafe behavior or unverified components that cause downstream harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Regulatory / Legal / Contractual Financial Liability (R-EX-5), Privacy Harm / Unauthorized Processing (R-IP-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Data Privacy Notice
compensating_control_1.justification: Data Privacy Notice (PRI-21) provides privacy protection that compensates for the absence of Product or Service Delivery Restrictions (PRI-13) by applying alternative privacy safeguards to protect personal data and honor data subject rights. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Data Subject Consent
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to enable data subjects to authorize the collection, receipt, processing, storage, transmission, sharing, updating and/or disposal of their Personal Data (PD), where the data subject is provided, prior to collection, with:
(1) Plain language explaining the potential data privacy risks of the authorization;
(2) A means to decline the authorization; and
(3) Necessary choice and consent-related criteria required by applicable statutory, regulatory and contractual obligations.
compensating_control_2.justification: Data Subject Consent (PRI-24) provides privacy protection that compensates for the absence of Product or Service Delivery Restrictions (PRI-13) by applying alternative privacy safeguards to protect personal data and honor data subject rights. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
